mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired skin segment into its original place was most worthwhile: the scar and connections made the earlier repair feel like part of the same body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the eye and ears separately felt a little repetitive because both clearly belonged in the head, although each showed its nerve connections.

surprise.text: The repaired segment filled only a small opening, with the rest of the skin supplied; its scar stayed visible.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures gave clear places or connections for each pairing.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how other parts fit into the whole model, though I would hope for choices beyond placing obviously matching pieces.
